records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue from software and related services was approximately 18% of our total revenue during 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •The decrease in software maintenance sales during 2022 was primarily related to a decrease in software maintenance renewals for perpetual licenses and the impact of changes in foreign currency exchange rates on the subsequent recognition of previously deferred amounts, partially offset by growth in subscription licenses, due to the shift to a subscription license model.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •The current portion of deferred revenue decreased by $1 million due to changes in foreign currency exchange rates and lower deferrals for software maintenance due to our ongoing transition to a subscription license model, partially offset by additional deferrals for hardware-related service-type warranty obligations.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As of December 31, 2022, we estimate our distributors were carrying approximately $18 million of our products in inventory in total, and the majority of our distributors are not eligible for price adjustments or stock rotations related to their previous purchases.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2022, operating income was $192 million, an increase of 63% compared to 2021.
